scientific_integrity: Algebraic matrix/adjugate proof with exhaustive finite exact polynomial certificate, explicit analytic local-limit assumptions and a standalone source-language checker. No experimental sequence data and no independent review or validation are claimed.
scientific_limitations: Counts exactly the linear four-letter words excluding tandem squares of block lengths one and two at each GC weight; not a correcting-code optimum, folding model, or longer-square constraint. The exponential rate is known in prior work; the exact composition law and evaluated central prefactor are the claims assessed. Possible unindexed equivalent enumeration remains a priority risk.
title: GC-content spectrum of short-tandem-irreducible DNA words
